messages:
deploybot: Scheduled rollout queued for 23:00 UTC. Mini-freeze window: 22:50–23:10. Pinning v3.4.2 to stable-slot. :calendar:

maria: Copy. Who's owning smoke at T+2m?

owen: I can. Will run canary checks and quick perf smoke.

sre_oncall: FYI I put standby on pager for 22:45–23:20. Alert thresholds: 5% error rate OR p95 latency > 800ms.

kevin_ops: Added a rollback playbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mini-freeze-rollback. Short summary: if errors spike, run `./scripts/rollback.sh v3.3.9` from ops box.

maria: Noted. Also: release notes short blurb ready? product_andy?

product_andy: Drafted RN in /docs/releases/3367. TL;DR: embedding cache change + batching tweak. No schema changes.

owen: Deploybot, can you confirm autoscaler warmup for the next hour?

deploybot: autoscaling: warmup ramps scheduled -> +30% capacity starting 22:40 UTC. Canary group: 2% traffic.

maria: Two quick checks for canary owner: 1) end-to-end text generation, 2) embeddings latency under 300ms.

owen: Got it. I'll run KPI script after push.

sre_oncall: If canary fails, immediate unpin + traffic-shift to v3.3.9. Kevin, can you prep unpin rights?

kevin_ops: I have manual unpin ready. Command on prod: `redwood pin set stable v3.3.9 --reason "canary fail"` — I'll standby.

maria: Also want a quick DB read-only check at T+1m. Owen — add to smoke checklist.

nowen: Added. Smoke checklist snippet: ```- run e2e/generate_smoke.py --canary -n 10
- check embeddings_latency.log
- curl /healthz | jq .status
- verify kv-cache-hit-rate > 60%```

product_andy: One policy note: if any customer-facing tests fail, we hold and escalate. No silent rollbacks. :rotating_light:

maria: Agree. If we rollback, we also revert quant config changes in configstore. Kevin, can you script that into rollback.sh?

kevin_ops: I'll add `configstore revert quant_profile` to rollback script, done.

deploybot: deploy started at 22:55:12 UTC -> pushing v3.4.2 to stable-slot (canary 2%).

nowen: Canary logs: first batch ok. p95 gen 210ms, embeddings 180ms. Looks healthy.

maria: Run full smoke now.

nowen: Smoke run: 10/10 passes, kv-cache-hit-rate 72%. Health: OK.

sre_oncall: Monitoring: error rate 0.4%, p95 220ms. Continuing watch.

maria: Proceed with stagger to 20% in 5m if stable.

deploybot: traffic adjustment: canary -> 20% at 23:02:00 UTC.

nowen: After ramp: p95 260ms, errors 0.6% (within threshold). No anomalies in stderr.

product_andy: I'm doing a quick sanity on customer flows — looks good in staging mirror.

maria: Ok, start final roll to 100% if no alarms in next 5. Reminder: keep quiet window until 23:15.

sre_oncall: No alerts for 6m. Continuing watch til 23:20.

kevin_ops: If we need emergency rollback, I'll execute and ping #incidents.

deploybot: rollout completed to 100% at 23:08:41 UTC. Pin remains v3.4.2.

maria: Great job everyone. After-action: drop a 1-paragraph note in release channel and attach smoke logs. I'll collect a short RCA if anything shows in the next 24h.

nowen: Uploading smoke logs to /artifacts/3367000001/smoke.log now.

product_andy: RN published. Thanks all. :tada:
